texto: Reported earnings increased compared to third quarter 2025 primarily due to reliable operations with higher margins on refined product sales and higher crude oil realizations, partially offset by unfavorable timing effects resulting from the rising price environment.

Production in the third quarter of 2026 was lower than a year ago primarily due to lower entitlements from higher prices and impacts from the Middle East conflict, partly offset by record production at operated assets in Australia, higher production in the Gulf of America and the inclusion of one month of Venezuela production following a change to equity accounting in the quarter.
U.S. refinery crude unit throughput set a new record of 1.09 million barrels per day, reflecting reliable crude unit capacity utilization of nearly 98 percent.

Cash flow from operations in the third quarter of 2026 was higher than a year ago, driven by higher earnings and increased cash distributions from Tengizchevroil LLP (TCO). Adjusted free cash flow benefited from a $1 billion loan repayment from TCO and proceeds from asset sales.
Capex in the third quarter of 2026 was lower than last year largely due to lower spend in the Permian Basin.
Total debt was reduced by an additional $3.5 billion and net debt was down $7.8 billion in the quarter, further strengthening Chevron’s balance sheet.

The company’s Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of one dollar and seventy-eight cents ($1.78) per share, payable December 10, 2026, to all holders of common stock as shown on the transfer records of the corporation at the close of business on November 18, 2026.

avisos.mensaje: Amortizaciones (D&A): «DepreciationAndAmortization» termina el 2009-03-31; solo se usa para años antiguos.
Depreciación: «DepreciationNonproduction» termina el 2011-12-31; solo se usa para años antiguos.
Beneficio antes de impuestos: «IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxesDomestic» termina el 2025-12-31; solo se usa para años antiguos.
Otros ingresos (gastos) no operativos: «OtherNonoperatingIncomeExpense» termina el 2018-03-31; solo se usa para años antiguos.
Dividendos pagados: «PaymentsOfDividends» termina el 2010-09-30; solo se usa para años antiguos.
Investigación y desarrollo (I+D): «ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense» termina el 2025-12-31; solo se usa para años antiguos.
Beneficio operativo: la compañía no lo publica; se usa beneficio antes de impuestos + gastos por intereses (EBIT).
Caja e inversiones a corto: se descarta «CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue» (último dato 2024-06-30, ingresos hasta 2026-06-30).
Deuda financiera: se descarta «LongTermDebtNoncurrent» (último dato 2018-09-30, ingresos hasta 2026-06-30).
Deuda financiera: se descarta «LongTermDebt» (último dato 2021-12-31, ingresos hasta 2026-06-30).
Deuda financiera: se descarta «LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations» (último dato 2025-12-31, ingresos hasta 2026-06-30).
Inmovilizado material neto: se descarta «PropertyPlantAndEquipmentNet» (último dato 2023-09-30, ingresos hasta 2026-06-30).
Ingresos 2020: caen un 32% frente a 2019. Posible operación discontinuada o reclasificación (como AppLovin 2023); compara años con cuidado.
